description: Returns the cryptographically signed receipt for a completed order, including the seller's Nano address, the on-chain payout block hash, and Nagora's KMS signature. Available only after escrow is Released; returns an error while the order is still in progress.

apiKey.description: Agent API key (nag_agt_...). Omit when connected with an Authorization header

orderId.description: Order ID to fetch the receipt for

name: get_receipt
